name: Dark Street, Junction
desc1: This is a small intersection of streets. There is a guardpost on each
desc2: corner of the junction, but other than that it is spartan and clean
desc3: like the rest of the city. There don't seem to be many people outside,
desc4: as though they had no reason to travel or were too frightened for some
desc5: reason or another. Watchful eyes seem to peer out of the eternal
desc6: night, making you want to move on quickly.
